resources.string: Gemini API key for reading aloud
Paste a key from Google AI Studio to have books read aloud. Requests are billed to that key.
The text being read aloud is sent to Google to make the voice.
Asking Gemini for its speech models…
This key has no speech models listed. Type one instead.
Gemini did not list its models.
Google\'s online voices, billed to your Gemini API key.
Google\'s Gemini, on your API key. Passages are sent to Google.
Google refused the Gemini API key.
Add your Gemini API key on the External services and API keys page to translate with Gemini.
Paste a key from Google AI Studio to read aloud or translate with Gemini. Requests are billed to that key.
Text read aloud or translated with Gemini is sent to Google.
Google\'s ML Kit translator, run on the phone once its languages are downloaded. Passages stay on the phone; ML Kit sends Google usage diagnostics.
Translate the page from here with Google
To translate on this phone, Google\'s translator needs: %1$s. Each language is about 30 MB and downloads over Wi-Fi only.
Connect to Wi-Fi first. Languages download over Wi-Fi only.
The download failed. Check the Wi-Fi connection and try again.
There is not enough free space on this phone for these languages.
Google\'s ML Kit translates on this phone, so book text is not sent to Google. ML Kit does send Google diagnostic and usage data, such as errors and timings.
Deleting a language keeps the translations already saved in your books.
The downloaded languages could not be listed.

Liseur is built from free and open-source components, except Google\'s ML Kit translation in this Google Play edition, which Google provides under its own terms.
Translations are powered by Google Translate technology, running on this phone through Google\'s ML Kit.

Book text stays on this phone. Once you choose it, Google\'s ML Kit starts sending Google diagnostic and usage data about itself, with an identifier for this installation. Language downloads also come from Google, only after you agree and only over Wi-Fi.
Languages download over Wi-Fi only. Book text never leaves this phone.
Could not delete it. Try again.
%1$s is your translation language. You will need to download it again to translate into it.
Google\'s Gemini, on your API key. Book text is sent to Google.
Add your Gemini API key on the External services and API keys page for the reading companion to use Gemini.
Book text from earlier chapters is sent to Google on your Gemini key, and whole chapters once background recaps are on. Google may charge for these requests.
